hero.title: Maison Milau Artisanal Coffee Roastery.
hero.subtitle: Artisanally roasted specialty coffees for every occasion. In your home, for the office, hospitality venues, or exclusive barista catering for your event.

promises.title: Maison Milau Promises
promises.subtitle: Our commitment to craftsmanship, freshness, and transparent excellence in every single cup.
promises.freshness_desc: No stale warehouse shelves. All our specialty coffees are small-batch artisanally roasted weekly in Oudegem.
promises.specialty_desc: Only fully traceable premium beans (SCA 84+ score), honoring origins, terroir, and the farmers who cultivate them.
promises.personal_desc: From curated tasting boxes to custom house blends for restaurants and businesses. We craft your distinct coffee profile.
promises.sustainability_desc: Direct trade relations, recyclable packaging, and fair compensation paid directly at the farm source.
